Footer.description: A foreign language center in Mukachevo. Learn in person or online.
Footer.heading: Contacts

Hero.title: English built around your goal — from entrance exams to working abroad.
Hero.body: Group, pair and individual lessons for school pupils, university students and adults. In person in central Mukachevo or online.
Hero.microcopy: {minutes} minutes • level check • introduction • personal plan — free.
Hero.mediaLabel: Branded SOVA media placeholder for a future real photo or video from the school
Hero.mediaNote: A real photo or video from SOVA will appear here.

Directions.title: What do you need English for?
Directions.intro: Do not pick a course at random. Start with the outcome — we will account for your level, deadline and preferred format.

GoalMatcher.title: Find your starting point.
GoalMatcher.intro: Choose one goal now. We will keep it in the link so you can continue from it in the short enquiry form.
GoalMatcher.question: What matters most to you?
GoalMatcher.emptyValue: Choose a goal on the right
GoalMatcher.emptyNote: This does not lock you into a programme — the final plan depends on your level and deadline.
GoalMatcher.selectedNote: Your choice is saved. We will use it to match the programme in the next step.
GoalMatcher.privacyNote: No contact details are needed at this step.

Formats.title: Clear before the first conversation.
Formats.intro: Choose the level of personalisation and budget that suit you. The programme within each format is adapted to your goal.
Formats.examNote: NMT, EVI and international exam preparation uses the same formats and the standard price of the format you choose.

Trial.title: We understand your goal first. Then we recommend a programme.
Trial.intro: This is a focused diagnostic session: we meet, assess your knowledge and agree on a realistic route to your outcome.
Trial.host: Your trial is led by a potential teacher or by an administrator / head teacher.
Trial.offlineBonus: For in-person study, we also show you around the school and introduce the learning materials.

apply.title: Send a short enquiry
apply.body: Share your goal and preferred format — no lengthy questionnaire.

connect.title: Arrange the session
connect.body: We contact you and find a convenient time.

diagnose.title: {minutes} min: test and diagnosis
diagnose.body: We meet, assess your knowledge and identify your current level.

plan.title: Receive a personal plan
plan.body: We recommend a programme, format and schedule, and explain the pricing clearly.

details.meet: introduction and context for your goal
details.programme: programme matched to your goal, level and deadline

Method.title: Do more than know the rules. Use English with confidence.
Method.intro: We combine a clear framework, regular practice and materials matched to each learner’s level and goals.
Method.standardsLabel: Standards and publishers used in our teaching

goal.title: A route built around your goal
goal.body: Once we know your level, we shape the programme around the outcome, deadline and pace that matter to you.

speaking.title: Speaking from the first lesson
speaking.body: Grammar is reinforced through real conversation and practical situations instead of remaining theory.

standards.title: CEFR and current materials
standards.body: We use CEFR levels and work with Cambridge, Oxford, Pearson and other up-to-date resources.

younger.title: Interactive learning for younger students
younger.body: Games and active tasks keep learners engaged; the usual rhythm is {min}–{max} lessons a week depending on format and goal.

Why.title: Evidence, not loud promises.
Why.intro: We combine the school’s experience, a clear method and formats that fit real life.

goal.title: Learning built around a specific goal
goal.body: Your level, deadline and desired outcome shape the programme — not the other way around. It starts with a free diagnosis and plan.

speaking.title: Speak, do not just study
speaking.body: A speaking-first approach turns rules into language you can use in real conversations.

materials.title: A strong system without outdated templates
materials.body: We work with CEFR and current materials from leading international publishers.

place.title: In central Mukachevo — or wherever you are
place.body: A comfortable modern space for in-person lessons and a complete online learning option.

smallGroups.title: Small groups and a clear start
smallGroups.body: More attention for each learner and a free {minutes}-minute diagnosis before you begin.

Location.title: SOVA in central Mukachevo.
Location.note: Paid parking is available nearby. You can also study online.
Location.mapTitle: Open the map showing SOVA in Mukachevo

FAQ.title: The essentials, answered.
FAQ.intro: Answers to common questions before you take the first step. We agree the details of your programme after the level check.
